about: How the catalogue's names become eBay UK's values (flip.ebay). models: the ones whose eBay name isn't the brand and the model ('Apple iPhone 13'). colours: eBay's plain colour (one of its 16) for each catalogue colour; the title keeps the exact name. Where the hue doesn't settle it, the colour UK sellers pick for that model, counted on eBay on 2 Sep 2026 (colour_evidence).

colour_evidence.Midnight: Black: 410 of 587 iPhone 13 listings saying midnight
colour_evidence.Starlight: White: 218 of 363 iPhone 13 listings saying starlight
colour_evidence.Natural Titanium: Silver: 311 of 634 iPhone 15 Pro listings (White 32, Black 25)
colour_evidence.Rose Gold: Pink: 185 iPhone SE listings saying rose gold (Gold 6)
colour_evidence.Coral: Orange: 25 of 45 iPhone XR listings saying coral
colour_evidence.Cream: Beige: 34 of 237 Galaxy S23 listings saying cream (most say none)
colour_evidence.Lavender: Purple: 75 of 243 Galaxy S23 listings, 12 of 76 iPhone 17
colour_evidence.Lime: Green: 87 of 94 Galaxy S23 listings saying lime
colour_evidence.Sage: Green: 16 of 67 iPhone 17 listings saying sage
colour_evidence.Ultramarine: Blue: 65 of 165 iPhone 16 listings saying ultramarine
colour_evidence.Teal: Blue, its hue: of 122 iPhone 16 listings saying teal, 38 say Pink (listings of several colours) and 16 Blue
colour_evidence.Desert Titanium: Gold, its hue: sellers split, Grey 60 and Gold 26 of 186 iPhone 16 Pro listings
